name: Related posts
description: Lists the posts that share the most tags, then categories, with the current post, in its language: as a card after each post and as a widget for single-post pages.
author: sap13ns

widgets.title: Related posts
widgets.description: The posts related to the post being read. Only shown on single-post pages.

config.label: Number of posts
config.help: 1 to 10. Empty uses the number from the plugin settings.

settings.label: Show after each post
settings.help: Adds a "Related posts" card at the end of every post. Turn it off to use only the widget.

settings.label: Show featured images
settings.help: Adds a small thumbnail. The host only offers the full-size image, so every thumbnail downloads the original file.

settings.label: Title
settings.help: Title of the card after the post. Empty uses "Related posts", or "Artículos relacionados" for Spanish posts. The widget uses the title set in Appearance → Widgets.
